description: This file provides functions for searching files and directories within a workspace using ripgrep and fuzzy search (fzf). It includes methods to execute ripgrep with configurable options, retrieve files with limits, and perform fuzzy search filtering.

methods.name: executeRipgrep
methods.description: Executes ripgrep with specified arguments to find files and directories, returning a list of FileResult objects.

methods.name: getRipgrepSearchOptions
methods.description: Retrieves additional ripgrep arguments based on VSCode search configuration settings.

methods.name: executeRipgrepForFiles
methods.description: Retrieves all files and directories in the workspace, applying filters and limits.

methods.name: searchWorkspaceFiles
methods.description: Performs a fuzzy search over workspace files and directories based on a query string, returning matching items.
